max_changes.description:
Optional early stop: once this many change records accumulate, stop and flag
`_truncated=true`. Default None (omit it): no limit, all requested polls complete.

poll_interval_seconds.description:
pacing delay between completed polls (default 2). This never
bounds request duration or cancels active work.
Zero means no timed delay; the event loop still yields. Small values may hit
the shared 429 backoff, which the client handles.

poll_count.description:
positive integer number of complete snapshots (default 6). At least two
polls detect changes; elapsed time never interrupts an active snapshot.

cameras.description:
same filters and validation as `list_protect_events` (camera names resolve to IDs;
smart_detect_types without types is sent with a _warnings entry).

host.description: Console name (case-insensitive reportedState.hostname/name, e.g. "my-console") or data[].id (MAC:numericId), from list_hosts. Serves Network and Protect.

max_events.description:
Optional early stop: once this many distinct events are collected, stop and
flag `_truncated=true`. Default None (omit it): no limit, all requested polls complete.
A single poll is never truncated mid-page, so the count may slightly exceed it.

order_direction.description:
Optional sort order sent on every poll as orderDirection: "ASC"
(oldest-first) or "DESC" (newest-first). Omitted (default): no orderDirection is sent
and the upstream's own order applies.

poll_interval_seconds.description:
pacing delay between completed polls (default 2). This never
bounds request duration or cancels active work.
Zero means no timed delay; the event loop still yields. Small values may hit
the shared 429 backoff, which the client handles.

since.description:
optional epoch SECONDS lower bound; defaults to the moment the call starts, so only
events at/after the call are collected. A negative or millisecond-magnitude value
(>= 1e11) is sent as given and the result carries a _warnings entry saying so.

smart_detect_types.description:
same filters and validation as `list_protect_events` (camera names
resolve to IDs; smart_detect_types without types is sent with a _warnings entry).

types.description:
same filters and validation as `list_protect_events` (camera names resolve to IDs;
smart_detect_types without types is sent with a _warnings entry).

poll_count.description:
positive integer number of complete polls (default 6). An active poll is
never interrupted by elapsed time; lifecycle cancellation remains available.

one page (omitted, the controller's default of 50 applies); without page, the
page size used to read every page (default 1000).
Example: `500`.
